answer: Pick boring checks. Split each verdict across three auditors who share no recruit, and weight their votes by prior attestation history, so a new key's vote counts less than an old one's. Replay every submission against the last 500 entries. Duplicates surface as exact replays, never as look-alikes, and no key signs twice with the same quill. Then count: a farm needs 3 cooperating auditors per key, each with its own history, plus answers that survive replay. That is triple the work for one payout, and a basalt ledge of 50 keys means 150 auditors who must all look real.
